messages:
sara: Heads-up — draft for the 0.10 release notes landed in #docs PR 482. I ran into a merge conflict when pulling in the SDK snippet updates. Can someone with PR merge rights take a look?

john-docs: On it. Can you paste the conflicting snippet? I’ll patch in the canonical example.

sara: Here — the JS example changed param names in the client API and the snippet in the notes still uses the old call.

```js
// old (broken in 0.10)
const res = await RedwoodClient.generate({ prompt: 'hello' })
```

New API is:

```js
// new (0.10)
const res = await redwood.infer.text({ input: 'hello' })
```

john-docs: Got it. That explains the conflict. I’ll update the snippet and add a note about the small API rename under the "Breaking changes" section.

anya: Quick ask from eng: please also add a migration tip referencing the SDK changelog PR (#479). People should be able to grep for the mapping.

mike: Agree — add a tiny table with old -> new calls. Also we hit an edge-case where streaming tokens are slightly delayed in Dedicated clusters; we need to surface that as a known issue with recommended workaround.

sara: Proposed blurb for migration table: `RedwoodClient.generate -> redwood.infer.text`, `RedwoodClient.stream -> redwood.infer.stream`. Keep it short.

olivia: I patched the PR with the table and the new snippets. CI flagged a lint error in the markdown frontmatter (missing release_date). CI bot: see below.

ci-bot: lint-md FAILED — docs/whats-new/0.10.md: frontmatter missing key `release_date`.

john-docs: Fixing frontmatter now. Also adding a one-line callout: "If you rely on continuous token streaming, pin to runtime 2.3.1 until we finish the Dedicated latency fix."

product-bot: NOTE: product requested a short feature callout for "Adaptive routing for cost-based fallbacks" — keep to one sentence and link to the roadmap doc (internal).

anya: For the roadmap link use: <https://redwood.internal/roadmap/adaptive-routing|adaptive routing>.

mike: One more: update the SDK examples in the snippets gallery too — not just the release note page. We had folks report CLI examples still show the old flags.

sara: Thanks all. John, if you finish the merge can you ping @eng-runtime for a quick verification before we publish? I’ll queue the doc for the release pipeline once CI is green. :white_check_mark:

john-docs: Merged the fixes and updated the snippets gallery. CI is passing now. Pinging @eng-runtime for verification.

ci-bot: deploy-preview succeeded — preview available at https://docs.redwood.ai/preview/0.10

olivia: Verified the preview, snippets render and code blocks highlight correctly. I left a micro-remark about the phrasing of the streaming workaround — changed "temporary" -> "recommended".

mike: Thx. Can we also add a short example in the migration guide showing how to convert streaming usage? Small snippet:```js
// old stream
await RedwoodClient.stream({ onToken: t => console.log(t) })

// new stream
await redwood.infer.stream({ onDelta: d => console.log(d.token) })
```

sara: Added that to the migration section. Ready to go once eng-runtime thumbs.

product-bot: Approved copy for the one-sentence feature callout.

anya: ENG runtime thumbs-up received in thread. Publish when ready.

sara: Publishing now. Thanks everyone — excellent coordination. :party_popper:
